# TikTok Video Downloader HD

> A free TikTok video downloader that runs in the browser. No login, no quota, no extension. An optional Android APK and iPhone Home Screen app are available.

Paste a public TikTok link, click Download, then choose MP4, MP3, or Story. The clean file is prepared in the background while a short ad is shown; closing the ad starts the save to the browser's default Downloads folder.

Canonical URL: https://tiktokvideodownloaderhd.vercel.app/

## What it can do

- Save TikTok videos without watermark as MP4, at exactly the resolutions the source offers with estimated file sizes.
- Extract MP3 audio at 192 kbps.
- Save an active TikTok story or a direct story media link as MP4.
- Download direct `.mp4`, `.webm` and `.ogg` links through the browser.
- Preview a prepared video in the browser before saving.

## How it works

TikTok links go through a small Python function using yt-dlp and are streamed back to the browser. Direct video links are fetched client-side into a Blob. Nothing is stored after the request ends. Large files and long videos use the same path, so the ad beat and save speed stay consistent.

## FAQ

The homepage has 30 FAQ answers in five sections: General FAQs, Download & Video Quality, Audio & Compatibility, Privacy & Copyright, and Troubleshooting.

- [Read the full FAQ](https://tiktokvideodownloaderhd.vercel.app/#faq)
- **Is it free?** Yes — no login, no quota, no extension; ads keep the tool running.
- **Watermark?** The original clean stream is used, so the TikTok overlay is not burned in.
- **Private or age-restricted clips?** Not supported; only public links can be read.
- **Formats?** HD MP4, 192 kbps MP3, and active story MP4.
- **Devices?** Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
- **Phone app?** Optional: Android APK and iPhone Add to Home Screen (PWA); the browser tool itself needs no install.
- **Where does the file go?** To the browser's default Downloads folder.
- **Do you store links or files?** No. Files are streamed directly and nothing is kept after the request.

Only download content you own or have permission to save. Not affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance.
